Not stopped: a server crontab calling wp cron or artisan schedule:run, wp action-scheduler run by hand, queue workers already running, code that opens SMTP sockets or uses fsockopen with credentials Roadie doesn't know, raw cURL without --echo-proxy. Credentials are blanked so those paths fail at the provider. Blocking outbound traffic at the host is the only certainty.

Pseudonymised, not anonymised. The copy still holds order totals, dates, products and anything Roadie can't recognise in free text. Treat it as personal data.

Mail from this copy goes to Echo at http://127.0.0.1:8025. Run rhythm echo up on the staging host, or the copy's mail will fail closed.

ALSO
- noindex: X-Robots-Tag, robots.txt Disallow: / and the crawler block (blog_public in the database left as it is)
- 3,912 production URLs rewritten in 2 tables
- Files are not copied. For uploads, leave out the folders that hold personal data: rsync -a --exclude wp-content/debug.log --exclude wp-content/uploads/wc-logs --exclude wp-content/uploads/gravity_forms --exclude wp-content/updraft --exclude wp-content/ai1wm-backups --exclude '*.sql' --exclude '*.sql.gz' --exclude '*.zip' deploy@shop.com:/var/www/shop/ /var/www/staging/
- Basic auth is off: --basic-auth <user> writes snippets for Apache, nginx and Caddy (Roadie never edits server config)
- Object caches and search indexes (Redis, Algolia, ElasticPress) are not copied or cleared
